headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty fell over 300 points, snapping a winning streak amid inflation concerns.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on market sentiment
Rising crude oil prices pressured the domestic indices
Global service disruptions following a major Microsoft outage
Profit booking as indices snapped a recent winning streak
whatHappening: Sensex fell 319 points to close at 25,144 in the last session
Nifty50 ended the last trading day below the 25,150 mark
Manappuram Finance shares dropped 4% during Friday's trade
Shriram Finance emerged as the top loser on the Nifty50
summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices snapped their winning streak as Sensex and Nifty fell due to inflation and oil pressures. Manappuram Finance and Shriram Finance were among the top laggards during the session. Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
